battle.name: 盧明月起義
battle.brief: 大業十年（614）十二月，涿郡人盧明月聚眾十餘萬至齊郡祝阿，與齊郡通守張須陀相持十餘日。張須陀以萬人邀之，糧盡乃佯退，預伏千人於葭葦，俟全軍追擊而奪柵焚柵，回軍奮擊大破之。卡面月牙劍屬青銅時代外彎單刃兵器，與本役相隔三千餘年，不在此役現場；同期陣上砍擊由環首刀與長槊擔當。

kit.name: 埃及月牙劍
kit.history: 外彎的單刃劍，砍下去不用拔。它比直劍更早出現在埃及人的手上。

countries: 這場衝突是隋朝中央與河北、山東、河南各郡縣的郡兵，同以涿郡人盧明月為首的起義聯軍之間的交戰，發生於大業十年（614）冬、到大業十三年（617）正月之間。隋方的指揮體系分兩層：前線由各郡的通守、郡丞領本郡兵自守，中央另派大員以行臺總攝河北討捕；齊郡通守張須陀以河南道十二郡黜陟討捕大使的名義，統一調度齊、魏、渤海、鉅鹿一帶的兵馬、糧秣與進剿權責，江都方面則由通守王世充領禁軍與郡兵，專責平定河南方向的盧明月。起義軍一方則是鬆散的聯盟：盧明月自稱無上王，史料僅記其眾數與號令，未見完整的官署與編制，部眾多為郡縣潰散的府兵、逃戶與鄉里百姓合編，裝備多取民間器物，甲胄極少，戰時靠首領威望與城邑糧食維繫戰力，一敗即容易崩散。河北同時還有竇建德（617年正月於樂壽稱長樂王）、李密（魏公）、劉武周（與突厥相結）、羅藝（自稱幽州總管）各部割據，隋朝名義上仍在，實控只剩江都與部分郡縣。
countriesEn: This clash pitted the commandery troops of Hebei, Shandong and Henan under the Sui court against the rebel confederation led by Lu Mingyue, a native of Zhuo Commandery, and it ran from the winter of Daye 10 (614) to the first month of Daye 13 (617). The Sui side worked on two levels. At the front, the tongshou (military governors) and commandery magistrates of each commandery led their own local soldiers in self-defence, while the centre sent senior commissioners who, as regional headquarters, took charge of the northern pacification. Zhang Xutuo, governor of Qi Commandery, in his capacity as Inspector for Advancement and Demotion and Pacification Commissioner over the twelve commanderies of the Henan Circuit, unified the deployment of troops, food and pursuit authority across Qi, Wei, Bohai and Julu; in Jiangdu, the governor Wang Shichong commanded palace guards and commandery troops with the single task of ending Lu Mingyue in Henan. The rebel side was a loose coalition. Lu Mingyue styled himself King Supreme, and the sources preserve only his numbers and his orders: no complete bureaucracy and no order of battle are recorded. His followers were largely a mix of disbanded palace-soldiers from the commanderies, absentees and local villagers, armed with whatever could be taken from civilians and almost wholly without armour. Their fighting power rested on the personal authority of their chief and on the grain of the towns they held, which is why a defeat so often dissolved them. Hebei was meanwhile already carved up by other rebel bands: Dou Jiande, who raised the title Prince of Chang Le at Leshou in the first month of 617; Li Mi, who called himself Duke of Wei; Liu Wuzhou, who linked himself to the Turks; and Luo Yi, who proclaimed himself Protector-General of Youzhou. The Sui dynasty still existed in name, but in practice it held only Jiangdu and a few commanderies.
people: 起義的發起人是盧明月，涿郡人，出身鄉里而熟悉軍情，隋末民變的諸多領袖中，他以起兵迅速、轉戰數省見稱。他在 大業十年起兵，短期內聚起十餘萬眾，先屯齊郡祝阿，後轉戰河南、淮北一線；官府起初只以流寇視之，數月之間便不得不以行臺、黜陟討捕大使這類臨時重權來應付。隋方主將是齊郡通守張須陀，他此前已平定屯於蹲狗山、眾十萬的左孝友部，威震東夏，靠列營逼敵、斷其糧秣的消耗打法著稱；此役中他判斷官軍糧盡難以久持，於是把佯退與奇襲綁在一處，親自設局。真正完成突襲的是兩名年輕將校：歷城人秦叔寶（名瓊，字叔寶）與少時即以驍勇聞名的羅士信。通鑑記二人請行時眾將無人敢應，叔寶與士信各分將千兵伏於葭葦，奪柵焚柵之後二人名聲大振；其後秦叔寶列唐室凌煙閣二十四功臣，羅士信則隨竇建德出戰，最終戰歿於與劉黑闥的交鋒之中。朝廷一端另有數位人物推動局勢：內史侍郎虞世基扣下各郡告敗表狀瞞住煬帝，御史韋雲起上書直指發兵不多、眾寡懸殊而諸將屢敗，河北討捕將楊義臣破降河北賊數十萬、列狀上聞卻被煬帝罷去兵權，樊子蓋在關中坑殺降者激起更深怨憤；直至大業十三年正月，煬帝才命江都通守王世充專討河南的盧明月。
peopleEn: The man who started the rising was Lu Mingyue, a native of Zhuo Commandery who had grown up among the local people and knew the military situation of the north intimately. Among the many leaders of the late-Sui revolts he was noted for raising his banner quickly and for carrying his war across several provinces. He rose in Daye 10, gathered more than a hundred thousand men in a short space of time, first camped at Zhua in Qi Commandery and afterwards ranged through Henan and the northern Huai region. The authorities at first dismissed him as nothing but a band of refugees; within a few months they had to answer with powers of real weight, ad hoc regional headquarters and the office of Inspector for Advancement and Demotion and Pacification Commissioner. The Sui commander was Zhang Xutuo, governor of Qi Commandery, who had already broken Left Xiaoyou's force of a hundred thousand men camped at Dourgou Mountain and had made his name in the eastern regions by camping close to the enemy and strangling their supplies. In this campaign he judged that his isolated force had run out of food and could not hold on, and so he bound a feigned retreat to a night raid, designing the trap himself. The two young officers who actually carried out the raid were Qin Shubao (Qin Qiong) of Licheng and Luo Shixin, who had been famous for his daring since boyhood. The Zizhi Tongjian records that when Zhang Xutuo asked who would volunteer, no one in the ranks answered until these two came forward. They led a thousand men hidden among the reeds, and after seizing the barricades and firing them they became famous overnight. Qin Shubao would afterwards be ranked among the twenty-four meritorious officials of Lingyan Hall under the Tang, while Luo Shixin joined Dou Jiande and was finally killed in action against Liu Heita. Several other figures at court shaped how the affair unfolded: the Internal History Vice Minister Yu Shiji held back the reports of defeat sent up by the commanderies so that the emperor should remain in the dark; the Censor Wei Yunqi memorialized that too few troops were dispatched, that the odds between the sides were hopeless, and that the generals had lost yet again; Yang Yichen, the pacification commissioner in Hebei, reported that he had broken and taken the surrender of several hundred thousand rebels and was rewarded only with dismissal and the dispersal of his troops; Fan Zigae buried surrendered men in Guanzhong, deepening the resentment. Only in the first month of Daye 13 did the emperor commission Wang Shichong, governor of Jiangdu, to destroy Lu Mingyue in Henan single-handedly.
kits: 卡面這件埃及月牙劍是青銅時代的典型外彎單刃兵器，形制上以刃部加寬如鐮，砍入之後不必費力拔出；它在工藝譜系上比直劍更早成熟，約前1500年前後的埃及新王國仍大量使用，隨後才逐漸被直身雙刃劍取代。就本役而言，月牙劍本身並不在場——它屬於同時代中亞與北非的冷兵器譜系，與河北齊郡的戰陣相隔三千餘年；它真正能對應到的是隋軍近身砍擊所用的環首刀：環首刀同樣是單刃，重量集中於刃部，著重劈砍而非穿刺，砍入人身或盾面之後因刃弧與重心而難以拔出，兩者的使用邏輯是相通的。隋軍同期裝備可分幾類：步兵以長槊為主兵器，槊刃修長，倚靠方陣與長兵互刺；騎兵佩環首刀而用馬槊，弓弩有步弓、臂弩、擘弩配以箭矢，護具以皮甲、札甲為主，另有方盾、團盾與拒馬；攻城則備雲梯、撞車、巢車與拋石車，糧秣靠牛車與人力轉運。起義軍的裝備與之差距極大：甲胄稀有，長兵以竹木為杆，刀以柴刀、朴刀與農具充數，弓多為鄉間小弓，攻城器械幾近於無，軍中甚至只能靠就食城邑與搶奪郡縣物資維持。
kitsEn: The khopesh on the card face is the classic out-curved single-edged sword of the Bronze Age, broadening toward the edge like a sickle so that a blow does not have to be twisted free; in the lineage of arms it is older than the straight sword, was still in wide use in Egypt around 1500 BC under the New Kingdom, and was only later displaced by straight double-edged blades. As far as this campaign is concerned, the khopesh itself was not on the field: it belongs to the cold-weapon spectrum of the same age in Central Asia and North Africa, some three thousand years away from the fighting line in Qi Commandery, Hebei. What it does correspond to is the ring-pommel dao used by the Sui for close work, for the ring-pommel dao too is single-edged, concentrates its weight toward the edge, and is meant to chop rather than thrust; once it has bitten into a body or a shield it is hard to withdraw because of its curvature and its balance, so the two weapons share the same logic of use. The Sui equipment of the period falls into several groups. Infantry fought with the long spear, the qiang, whose blade was long and slender, relying on square formations and long weapons thrust at one another; cavalry carried the ring-pommel dao and used the horse lance; bows and crossbows were the foot bow, the single-armed and the powerful drawn crossbow, served with arrows; armour was chiefly hide and lamellar, supplemented by rectangular and round shields and by caltrops; for siege work the army carried scaling ladders, battering rams, observation towers and stone-throwing carts, while food and ammunition moved on ox carts and on human backs. The rebels' equipment was a very different matter: armour was scarce, long weapons were shafts of bamboo and wood, blades were kitchen knives, sabres and farm tools, bows were the small bows of the countryside, siege engines were almost absent, and the army could barely keep itself fed by quartering on towns and seizing the stores of the commanderies.
tactics: 祝阿之役的關鍵，在於一整套以退為餌的攻柵戰術。張須陀先列營逼近盧明月的大營，以逼近本身製造壓力：雙方相持十餘日，官軍孤軍深入、糧秣告罄，難以再拖；他不硬攻，而是決定撤退誘敵，隨即對將士說明，若賊眾見我軍退必傾巢追來，可用千人襲其營，並公開問誰願往，眾將無語，只有羅士信與秦叔寶請行。於是須陀捨棄營柵西遁，令二人分領千兵埋伏於葭葦之中；盧明月果然傾全軍追擊，柵寨空隙與守備鬆懈的破綻就此顯露。士信、叔寶驟馳至柵下，柵門閉塞，二人超升其樓，各殺數人，營中大亂；隨後斬關納入外兵，並縱火焚燒三十餘柵，煙焰漲天，寨中士卒驚潰。明月奔還，須陀回軍奮擊，叛軍大敗，僅以數百騎遁去，俘斬無算。這套連環設計的精要在於三點：一是佯退必須真捨棄營柵，讓追兵相信官軍潰敗；二是預伏位置選在葭葦，貼近敵軍的追擊路線；三是破柵不靠正面強攻，而靠奪門樓、斬關、焚柵的火攻，一舉摧毀三十餘座營寨的整體結構。叛軍的失誤則在於柵寨密集而守備分散、追擊慾望壓過營務警戒，一旦全軍壓上，縱有十餘萬眾也無從回頭。隋廷另一層的戰術在城防：大業十一年二月下詔令民眾悉數城居、田地就近支給，驛亭村塢一併築城，等於以城寨體系切割叛軍的活動空間，也逼得流民只能在糧食所在處聚集，這種政策對盧明月這類以河南鄉鎮為根基的部眾影響尤深。
tacticsEn: The key to the battle of Zhua lay in a complete assault technique built on a feigned retreat used as bait. Zhang Xutuo first camped his troops close against Lu Mingyue's great camp, using the approach itself to create pressure: after the two sides had stood off for more than ten days, the imperial army, isolated and deep in hostile country, had run out of food and could not hold on. Rather than assault, he decided to withdraw and draw the rebels on, and he explained to his men that if the enemy saw his troops falling back they would come with the whole mass, and that a thousand men might seize their camp; he then asked openly who was willing to go, and no one answered until Luo Shixin and Qin Shubao stepped forward. Xutuo therefore abandoned his barricades and withdrew westward, ordering the two of them to lead a thousand men who lay hidden among the reeds. Lu Mingyue duly pursued with his entire army, and the gaps in the barricade lines and the slackness of the watch were now exposed. Shixin and Shubao galloped up to the barricade, found the gate barred, climbed over the tower and each killed several men, throwing the camp into confusion; they then cut the gate open to admit the troops outside and set fire to more than thirty of the barricades, the flames and smoke rising into the sky as the defenders scattered. Mingyue fled back, Xutuo turned his army and struck, and the rebels were routed, escaping with only a few hundred horsemen while the count of killed and captured was beyond reckoning. The elegance of the design lay in three points. First, the feigned retreat had to mean really abandoning the barricades, so that the pursuers would believe the imperial army had collapsed. Second, the ambush was placed among the reeds, close to the line along which the enemy would pursue. Third, the barricades were not taken by frontal assault but by seizing the gate towers, cutting the gates and firing the shelters, which destroyed in one stroke the whole structure of more than thirty camps. The rebels' error lay in the density of their barricades combined with divided watch, and in pursuit appetite that outweighed caution: once the entire host pressed forward, even a hundred thousand men could not turn back. A second layer of Sui strategy lay in the defensive fortification of the towns. In the second month of Daye 11 an edict ordered the people to move into the towns, with fields allotted close to hand, and ordered the post stations, country villages and fortified hamlets alike to be walled; this cut the operating space of the rebels along lines of town and village, and at the same time forced the displaced population to gather only where grain could be found, a policy that told heavily on followers such as Lu Mingyue's, whose base was the country towns of Henan.
data: 戰役留下的數字，多數出自《資治通鑑》與《隋書》的概數，讀時須分清官軍記載與叛軍自報。祝阿之役，盧明月方面眾十餘萬，張須陀將萬人邀之，雙方兵力約為十比一；相持十餘日後官軍糧盡，須陀以千人奇襲，焚其三十餘柵，明月以數百騎遁走，所俘斬無算——說明受創極重而未被全殲。大業十一年（615）十月，盧明月帥眾十萬寇陳、汝，由陳郡、汝南、襄城一帶轉掠河南，行程數百里，直至淮北；到大業十三年（617）正月，部眾號四十萬，並自稱無上王。四十萬顯然是起義軍自報的號眾數，與祝阿之戰的十餘萬同屬概數，不宜當作實點人數。反觀官軍一側，隋廷在河南道設十二郡黜陟討捕大使，張須陀由此取得跨郡調兵權；涿郡為征遼前線，器械資儲堆積如山、屯兵數萬，成為起義軍覬覦的目標。朝廷另一組數字則反映平叛體制的效率問題：河北討捕將楊義臣破降河北賊數十萬，列狀上聞後卻被罷去兵權，賊勢隨即復盛。全役自大業十年十二月起，至大業十三年正月終，前後約兩年零一個月。
dataEn: Most of the numbers left by this campaign are round figures in the Zizhi Tongjian and the Sui Shu, and they have to be read with care, distinguishing what the government recorded from what the rebels claimed for themselves. At Zhua the rebel side is given as more than a hundred thousand men, while Zhang Xutuo is recorded as bringing ten thousand to meet them, an odds of roughly ten to one; after the ten-odd days of standoff the imperial army ran out of food, and Xutuo struck with a thousand men, burning more than thirty of the barricades, while Mingyue escaped with a few hundred horsemen and the count of killed and captured was beyond reckoning, which shows that the rebels were badly mauled but not annihilated. In the tenth month of Daye 11 (615) Lu Mingyue led a hundred thousand men against Chen and Ru, sweeping through Henan from the neighbourhood of Chen Commandery, Runan and Xiangcheng over a journey of several hundred li and pushing on to the northern Huai; by the first month of Daye 13 (617) his following was numbered at four hundred thousand and he styled himself King Supreme. Four hundred thousand is plainly the self-declared strength of the rebel host, a round figure of the same kind as the hundred-odd thousand at Zhua, and should not be treated as a head count. On the government side, the Sui set an Inspector for Advancement and Demotion and Pacification Commissioner over the twelve commanderies of the Henan Circuit, which gave Zhang Xutuo authority to move troops across commandery lines; Zhuo, the staging base for the campaigns against Goguryeo, held piled-up stores of weapons and equipment and a garrison of several tens of thousands, and it was exactly this wealth that the rebels coveted. Another set of figures bears on the efficiency of the pacifying apparatus: Yang Yichen, the pacification commissioner in Hebei, broke the rebel bands and took the surrender of several hundred thousand men, and after his report had been laid before the emperor his command was dissolved and his troops dispersed, whereupon the rebels grew strong again. The whole campaign runs from the twelfth month of Daye 10 to the first month of Daye 13, a little over two years and one month.
cause: 起義的直接背景，是隋朝連年大規模征遼與此起彼伏的民變把河北、山東逼到臨界。大業八、九、十年間三次出師高句麗，人力、物力、器械一齊抽空；通鑑記涿郡屯兵數萬，器械資儲盡積於此，起義軍接踵而至，爭的就是這批儲備。徵發與括戶使生計難以為繼，通鑑記大業末年的局面是民外為盜賊所掠、內為郡縣所賦，而戶口逃亡、盜賊繁多迫使朝廷在615年二月下詔民悉城居、驛亭村塢皆築城，這道命令本身就說明地方秩序已難以維持。情報封閉更使官府失去預警：各郡的告敗求救表狀被內史侍郎虞世基抑損不報，煬帝甚至責問河北討捕將楊義臣我初不聞；楊義臣破降河北賊數十萬，換來的卻是被罷去兵權、兵散賊再盛。地方軍鎮也失去可靠的約束，涿郡虎賁郎將趙什住不能拒賊，雲陽羅藝獨出戰破賊、聲名日重，隨後殺郡丞、據幽州，自稱幽州總管。盧明月是涿郡人，熟悉軍情與糧道，又生在祝阿、陳郡一線物資集中的節點上，聚眾的速度遠超尋常郡兵能反應的時間；到617年正月部眾自稱四十萬、自稱無上王時，隋廷才不得不把平叛任務交給江都通守王世充專責處理。
causeEn: The immediate background to the rising was that repeated large-scale campaigns against Goguryeo and the never-ending sequence of local revolts had pushed Hebei and Shandong to the breaking point. Three expeditions were mounted against Goguryeo in the eighth, ninth and tenth years of Daye, and manpower, supplies and weapons were all drained away; the Zizhi Tongjian records that Zhuo held several tens of thousands of garrison troops with its stores of weapons and equipment piled up there, and the rebels came in the wake of the armies precisely to lay hands on that wealth. Levy and the registration of households left the population unable to subsist, and the Tongjian describes the situation in the last years of Daye in the words that the people were plundered by bandits from without and taxed by the commanderies from within, while runaway households and rampant robbery forced the court in the second month of 615 to order the people to live in the towns and to wall the post stations and country villages, an edict that in itself shows how hard the local order had become to maintain. The sealing of information deprived the authorities of warning: the reports of defeat and requests for help from the commanderies were trimmed and suppressed by the Internal History Vice Minister Yu Shiji, and the emperor could even reproach the Hebei pacification commissioner Yang Yichen, saying that he had heard nothing of it at first; Yang Yichen broke the Hebei rebels and took the surrender of several hundred thousand men, and was repaid by dismissal, the dispersal of his troops and the renewed growth of the insurgents. The regional garrisons had equally lost reliable control: at Zhuo the officer of the Tiger Guard, Zhao Shizhu, could not hold the raiders off, while the Yunyang officer Luo Yi went out to fight alone, broke the bandits and saw his fame grow day by day, and then killed the commandery magistrate, seized Youzhou and proclaimed himself Protector-General of Youzhou. Lu Mingyue was a man of Zhuo who knew the military situation and the grain routes, and he rose on a line where the stores of Qi, Chen and the neighbouring commanderies were concentrated; the speed with which he gathered men far outran anything the ordinary commandery troops could respond to, and by the first month of 617, when his host was claimed at four hundred thousand and he had taken the title King Supreme, the Sui court had no choice but to hand the task of suppression to Wang Shichong, governor of Jiangdu, and let him deal with it on his own responsibility.
impact: 此役的影響，第一層在隋朝自身的平叛體制：郡縣自守成為常態，黜陟討捕大使這類跨郡臨時授權開始填補中央權力的空隙，張須陀也因平定左孝友、擊破盧明月而威名益盛，累遷齊郡通守、領河南道十二郡黜陟討捕大使，肩上的跨郡調度責任越來越重。第二層在將才的培育：秦叔寶與羅士信正是在這次奇襲中嶄露頭角，隋末的大亂把一批年輕武人推到前線——秦叔寶後隨秦王府，列凌煙閣二十四功臣；羅士信後歸竇建德，最終戰歿於與劉黑闥的交鋒。第三層在政治格局：盧明月自稱無上王的舉動，與同年竇建德於樂壽稱長樂王、劉武周自稱大丞相、李密稱魏公、杜伏威在江淮自立相互呼應，說明隋室的崩解已進入群雄割據、各建名號的階段，郡縣不再服從中央而各自結寨自守。第四層是負面的教訓：官軍對降者坑殺、地方平叛大將屢遭罷權，使起義軍屢敗屢起，而城居築城的政策雖限制了流寇的活動，也把流民推向依賴城寨的武裝化生存方式，為後來的城門大戶與地方割據埋下伏筆。
impactEn: The consequences of this campaign fall into four layers. The first concerns the Sui's own apparatus for suppressing revolt: self-defence by the individual commandery became the normal state of affairs, and ad hoc grants of authority across commandery lines, of the kind embodied by the Inspector for Advancement and Demotion and Pacification Commissioner, began to fill the gaps left by the centre. Zhang Xutuo's name grew with the defeat of Left Xiaoyou and of Lu Mingyue, and he was raised to governor of Qi Commandery and given charge of the twelve commanderies of the Henan Circuit, so that the weight of cross-commandery command grew steadily on his shoulders. The second layer is the schooling of commanders: Qin Shubao and Luo Shixin first showed themselves in exactly this raid, because the great disorder of the late Sui pushed a generation of young fighting men to the front, and Qin Shubao afterwards served in the household of the Prince of Qin and was ranked among the twenty-four meritorious officials of Lingyan Hall, while Luo Shixin later joined Dou Jiande and was finally killed in action against Liu Heita. The third layer is political: the act of proclaiming oneself King Supreme found its echo in Dou Jiande's assumption of the title Prince of Chang Le at Leshou in the same year, in Liu Wuzhou's proclamation as Great Chancellor, in Li Mi's style of Duke of Wei, and in Du Fuwei's independent position in the Jiangnan, all of which shows that the collapse of the Sui had entered a stage of rival warlords each erecting their own names and institutions, while the commanderies ceased to obey the centre and each entrenched itself behind its own fortified village. The fourth layer consists of the harder lessons: the burying of surrendered men by imperial troops and the repeated removal from command of provincial commanders who had won battles allowed the revolts to rise again after every defeat, while the policy of concentrating the population in walled towns, though it cramped the roaming bands, also drove the displaced population towards an armed way of life organised around fortified settlements, planting the seeds of the walled households and regional potentates that would follow.
result: 大業十年十二月的祝阿之役，盧明月的前鋒與營寨遭到重創：三十餘柵被焚，俘斬無算，本人僅以數百騎遁走；但他並未被消滅，反而轉戰河南。大業十一年（615）十月，他率眾十萬寇陳郡、汝南，進取襄城一帶，輾轉至淮北，部眾號四十萬，自稱無上王，達到聲勢的頂點；同一時期河北的竇建德亦於樂壽稱長樂王，江淮的杜伏威攻入歷陽，隋廷已無力同時應付多路。真正的結局在大業十三年（617）正月：煬帝命江都通守王世充討之，戰於南陽，王世充大破叛軍，斬盧明月，餘眾皆散，這支在河北、山東、河南三地流轉近兩年的起義軍就此瓦解。盧明月之死並未終結反隋鬥爭，反而使河北與河南的主導權轉到竇建德與李密手中；老對手張須陀隨後仍在北方與竇建德、李密、劉黑闥周旋，直至武德年間戰歿。從全局看，盧明月起義的結果，是隋朝在河北防線的崩解被提前公開，也讓隋末自大業七年起、歷時近二十年的動亂，以郡兵不足恃、須倚重跨郡行臺與名將的方式定型。
resultEn: In the battle of Zhua in the twelfth month of Daye 10, the vanguard and the camp works of Lu Mingyue were badly mauled: more than thirty barricades were burned, the count of killed and captured was beyond reckoning, and the rebel leader himself escaped with only a few hundred horsemen. He was not destroyed, however, and turned instead towards Henan. In the tenth month of Daye 11 (615) he led a hundred thousand men against Chen Commandery and Runan, pushed into the neighbourhood of Xiangcheng, and wheeled as far as the northern Huai, where his following was numbered at four hundred thousand and he took the title King Supreme, the high point of his rising. In the same period Dou Jiande assumed the title Prince of Chang Le at Leshou in Hebei and Du Fuwei broke into Linyang in the Jiangnan, and the Sui court no longer had the strength to meet several fronts at once. The real ending came in the first month of Daye 13 (617): the emperor ordered Wang Shichong, governor of Jiangdu, to take the field against him; they fought at Nanyang, where Wang Shichong routed the rebels, took Lu Mingyue's head, and the rest of the host scattered, and the rising that had roamed for nearly two years across Hebei, Shandong and Henan came to an end. Lu Mingyue's death did not finish the anti-Sui struggle; on the contrary it handed the initiative in Hebei and Henan to Dou Jiande and Li Mi, while his old opponent Zhang Xutuo continued to manoeuvre in the north against Dou Jiande, Li Mi and Liu Heita until he fell in battle in the Wude years. Seen as a whole, the outcome of the Lu Mingyue rising was that the collapse of the Sui defensive line in Hebei was made public ahead of time, and that the long disorder beginning in the seventh year of Daye and lasting nearly twenty years settled into its final form: the troops of the commanderies could no longer be relied on, and the state had to lean on regional headquarters with authority across commanderies and on individual commanders of renown.
